findings.problem: Other one-word police commands for stopping also fit the prompt and hint, such as ¡Deténgase!, ¡Párese! and ¡Deténganse!, so 'alto' is not the only right answer.
findings.fix: en: Halt! | hint: one-word police or military command, not a verb form

back.es: Halt! / Stop! (interjection, a command to stop)

note: The trick works well because Spanish 'alto' (stop) and English 'halt' come from the same German root.
